page5_s2.raw_text: If you are age 65 or older, you may designate a third-party to whom we shall transmit all important notices concerning your insurance policy.

page5_s3.section_title: HOW TO NOTIFY THE COMPANY OF THIS ELECTION
page5_s3.raw_text: You must complete the bottom portion and return it to New York Central (or your Agent) by certified mail, return receipt requested.

page5_s4.raw_text: Should you desire to terminate this agreement please send us a letter by certified mail, return receipt requested, requesting this.

page5_s5.raw_text: The third-party designee agrees to accept and receive copies of all cancellation, nonrenewal, and conditional renewal notices that are mailed to the senior citizen insured named above. Designation as a third-party shall not constitute acceptance of any liability on the third-party for services provided to such senior citizen. The third- party designee may terminate their status as a third-party designee by providing written notice to both the insurer and the senior citizen insured.
